_comment: Friday's capability registry: the TARGET architecture, and what is actually
This file is the contract. Skills, CLAUDE.md and the CLI all read it, so
there is exactly one place that knows whether a capability exists. That
matters because the alternative is what supabase.yml already does with its
hardcoded function list: a description of reality that drifts from reality
and fails silently when it does.
workflow   Riley's front door. Task-shaped, few, appear in `friday help`.
primitive  The engine. Precise, namespaced, for agents and for workflows
to orchestrate. Hidden from `friday help` unless asked for.
STATUS is either `implemented` or `planned`. A planned capability prints
what it will do and exits non-zero. It never pretends to have worked.
THE RULE FOR AGENTS: if you need a planned capability, implementing it in
Friday is the next development task. Do not route around Friday with an ad
hoc shell command — the invariant Friday enforces is the reason it exists.

check.summary: Machine, secrets, project config, repo and fast code checks, ending in one next action.

fix.summary: Format and auto-fix everything that can be fixed without judgement.
fix.blockedBy: The repo has no formatter. Adding one is a separate, deliberate reformat commit.

test.summary: The full gate: format, lint, types, unit, e2e, export.

ship.staging.summary: Run the gate, ship to staging, print where to go try it.

ship.production.summary: Preflight, plain-English diff, snapshot, typed confirmation, then the ordered ship.
ship.production.blockedBy: supabase/refs.json is not filled in, and there is no production gate in the pipeline yet.

release.summary: Drive one versioned release across web, iOS and Android.

undo.summary: Print the verified restore command, and how many player attempts it would discard. Never runs it.

capabilities.summary: What Friday is designed to do, and what is built of it.

quality.format.blockedBy: No formatter in the repo yet.

quality.export.summary: Build and validate the static export the native shells package.
